asset: Traditional Hokkaido kibori-kuma bear biting salmon v18 — genuine Harness GLB
reviewer: ChatGPT direct inspection of four actual Blender Cycles GLB renders, not AI-generated images

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Shoulder-rump distance is visibly shorter and hump stronger; head-to-body proportions remain rounded and stylized, feet still column-like.

face_and_expression.reason: The bear's forehead is like a smooth helmet and eyes/ears are attached-looking details. Nose overlaps the fish without believable cheeks or brow.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Salmon has somewhat fuller head and gill form but continues to read as a long tan wedge/plank across an open shelf-like mouth. Operculum is not convincingly continuous.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Torso remains marked by regular, rippled fur scars instead of irregular hand-cut sharp fur grooves; material reads waxy grey-brown rather than stained wood.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Feet slightly broader, but each leg remains a tubular column and toe cuts are very small separate scratches.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Actual front, three-quarter, back-left and top rendered views are all readable and reveal the shape issues.

defects.finding: Fish appears to rest on broad, separated jaw ledges rather than be clamped by a recognizable bite; gill plate and head are still geometric.
defects.required_fix: Resculpt upper snout, lower jaw and teeth/lip profile around natural salmon head/body with true intersection and depth.

defects.finding: The torso is less long but the face is flat and eyes look like stuck-on pins, with many smooth toy-like convex surfaces.
defects.required_fix: Separate short snout plane from broad cranium, build continuous cheeks, inset eye sockets and correct ears; improve front-paw anatomy.

defects.finding: Across shoulder and torso fur appears as repeating soft sine-ripple markings, not fine carved wood gouges.
defects.required_fix: Use irregular directional strokes organized around shoulders and neck, sparse sharp chisel facets and subdued wood-specular response.

defects.finding: Paws are wide but look like four socks with token grooves.
defects.required_fix: Integrate carved toes and low wedge-shaped nail tips into front and hind foot mesh.

improvement_tasks: Reject v18 (technical GLB build succeeded). Keep artifact and hashes for repeatable comparison.
Focus next iteration on facial high-poly continuity, jaw bite intersection and recognizably natural salmon before material tinkering.
Retain compact torso proportion as a promising change; refine limb anatomy instead of lengthening the barrel.
Reference real Asahikawa salmon-carved bear and Yakumo fur-carving photos without copying source images into generated 3D.
